en: Black-and-white postcard view of a large church with a tall, pointed clock tower topped by a cross. The nave has a steep roof and the walls are heavily covered with ivy or other climbing plants. In the foreground there is a lush garden or cemetery with flowers, shrubs, and gravestones. At the bottom margin of the image there is a printed caption identifying the location and the church.
